# Data Directory

**Author:** M. El Aabaribaoune

## Purpose
Manages the data lifecycle for the SMAP-XAI project.

## Structure
- `interim/`: Intermediate standardized datasets (extracted from native models but not fully harmonized).
- `processed/`: Fully harmonized, XAI-ready canonical data.

## Conventions
**Important:** Files in this directory and all subdirectories are generated by project scripts. Do NOT manually modify generated NetCDF products. Regenerate through the corresponding preprocessing script. Generated data must NOT be described as hand-edited source data.
